ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota and identify potential perpetrators
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover fraud and mismanagement
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and mismanagement in child care programs, potentially leading to arrests and convictions. By following the money trail, we can identify key players and uncover the scope of the problem.
